title: Speed, energy, transfer and void upgrades

rows: Reduces the ordinary processor duration according to the configured bonus.
Reduces eligible process cost according to the configured discount.
Actively exports finished items through permitted output faces.
Explicitly discards completed overflow when enabled. This is intentionally lossy.

blocks.text: Special machine programs can have their own timing and energy rules; a visible upgrade slot does not mean every world action uses the ordinary process formula. The recipe reader labels its baseline calculations as before installed upgrades.

Transfer throughput scales with upgrade count up to its configured cap. In the shipped settings each Transfer Upgrade contributes four items per transfer, with a cap of 64. These are defaults, not a substitute for the server configuration.
